Class Animator

  • Constructor Details

    • Animator

      public Animator(Structure structure, AnimationRequestData data, IAnimationComponent animationComponent, IAnimatedBlockContainer animatedBlockContainer)
      Constructs a Animator.

      Once created, the animation does not start immediately. Use startAnimation() to start it.

      Parameters:
      structure - The Structure that is being animated.
      data - The data of the movement request.
      animationComponent - The animation component to use for the animation. This determines the type of animation.
      animatedBlockContainer - The manager of the animated blocks. This is responsible for handling the lifecycle of the animated blocks.

  • Method Details

    • stopAnimation

      public void stopAnimation()
      Stops the animation gracefully. May cause the animation to restart later.

    • abort

      public void abort()
      Aborts the animation.

      Unlike blockingAbort(), this method does not block until the animation has finished.

    • blockingAbort

      public void blockingAbort()
      Aborts the animation and blocks until the animation has finished.

      Note that this excludes database operations, which are always asynchronous.

      If it is undesirable to block the main thread, use abort() instead.

    • startAnimation

      public void startAnimation()
      Replaces all blocks of the Structure with animated blocks and starts the animation.

      Note that if skipAnimation is true, the blocks will be placed in the new position immediately without any animations.
